Name: Custom Fence Decay
Author: JeanSebGwak
Description:
This mod will allow you to customize your fences decaying speed.

[quote]You can choose to have the same decaying speed to all fences types or set it individually.

By default, the mod reduce the decaying base speed by 2, but you can keep the base speed by setting the value to 100 or remove the decaying by setting to 0.

This mod manage wood, stone, iron and hardwood fences. If, for some reason, an other type of fence is used (From a mod for example), the value setted to "Fences decaying speed" setting will be used, it is the fallback value.

As the base game, "gold clock" item is taken into account.[/quote]
[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

[quote]I recommend to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod, but you can still configure it by going into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods/CustomFenceDecay [/i]and opening [i]config.json[/i]. ([b]If you don't see the file, please start the game and recheck it[/b])

[b]Important: If you set value directly in the config.json, the expected values for decaying are 0 to 100. [/b]
If you put less than 0, it will be considered as 0.
If you put more than 100, you will increase the decaying speed. (I let this possibility)[/quote]
[b][size=5]Translations[/size][/b]
This mod is delivered with two translations: English and French. If someone want to add more translations, feel free to do it, you have the permission.


As it's my first mod, don't hesitate to tell me if something can be improved and of course, if something is bugged.
Moreover, thanks to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] modders, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] modders and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20802]No Fence Decay Redux
[/url]modder to let their source code public. It allows me to better understand how to develop my mod.
